candidates.description: This vector activates on religious and ceremonial practices, places of worship, and spiritual figures.
This feature activates on verbal suffixes and noun-forming derivational suffixes used to indicate actions, processes, or their completed states.
This vector represents quantity, multiplicity, or variation in amount and diversity.
This vector represents the concept of difference, variance, and change.
This vector represents the concept of instances, occurrences, or events happening across various contexts and frequencies.
This vector represents the concept of rules, permissions, and constraints governing actions or behaviors.
This vector represents the concept of interpretation, meaning, and semantic representation.
This vector represents concepts related to established norms, traditions, and foundational standards.
This vector represents cognitive, perceptual, and analytical verbs related to noticing, understanding, or evaluating information.
This vector represents established cultural or social practices, traditions, and behavioral norms.
